trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Leonida Legend is the closing receipt of the set. Nothing extra is asked of you: it arrives when the other fifty-four entries are on the account.

steps.text: Treat it as an audit, not a task — clear the remaining fifty-four lines one by one.
Stay on a single playthrough; the entire list is offline, so there is no online waiting room.
Take one manual save at every chapter boundary to protect any window you have not closed yet.
Leave cheats off for the whole run; they suppress trophy awards on the session where they are used.
After the last bronze registers, the platinum is granted automatically on the same profile.
Final check: reconcile “Vice Got a Price!” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing opens the story. The trophy is tied to the prologue's final beat, so see the mission through instead of wandering the beach.

steps.text: Start Gone Fishing from the opening sequence and follow the scripted beats to its last objective.
Stay with the mission until the completion card appears; the trophy is awarded on that card.
This is an early window: finishing later chapters without it does not close the prologue, but a clean save helps.
Watch the balcony interlude in Chapter 1 before you sprint past it — it is the nearby missable beat.
If the card passes with no award, reload the manual save taken before the final objective.
Final check: reconcile “Just Like Paradise” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 ends here. The chapter is short, but it carries a separate meditation window that people often leave behind.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 1 missions in order and do not skip the free-roam section after them.
Before the chapter-complete card locks, use the balcony meditation spot highlighted by both guide sets.
Return to the same spot on the roof and hold the meditation input until the prompt closes.
Only then let the chapter end; the trophy for the chapter itself fires on its own.
Keep the pre-chapter manual save until you have both the chapter trophy and the meditation registered.
Final check: reconcile “Paradise Lost” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 is the straight-line second act. Finish its mission chain; the trophy is not tied to a medal or a side activity.

steps.text: Pick up the Chapter 2 chain from the map marker and work through it in listed order.
Ignoreoptional stranger jobs until the chapter card appears, so the story marker stays unambiguous.
The completion card is the trigger; a gold medal is not required for this one.
Use the Chapter 2 save point to test any risky side activity without replaying the act.
Record the card on your checklist and move to Chapter 3 with the same save file.
Final check: reconcile “T**s Ass Drug Money” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 closes with the Cartel Heist and also holds a stranger-race window. The chapter trophy itself only needs the story finished.

steps.text: Advance the Chapter 3 missions until the heist planning sequence unlocks.
Complete The Cartel Heist (the gta.guide name for the chapter's climax) to satisfy Break the Bank.
While the chapter is open, clear the Race Against Yago beat listed as missable by BestGTA6.
Let the chapter-complete card resolve before switching to side content in bulk.
If the race beats the chapter card, keep both flags in your notes rather than assuming one trophy covers the other.
Final check: reconcile “Vice City, Baby!” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the densest narrative act: Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown all sit inside it, with three trophies keyed to those missions.

steps.text: Work the Chapter 4 mission list in sequence rather than jumping between marker colours.
Complete Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown as they appear — each has its own trophy.
Clear the stranger strands that open in this chapter before leaving the act.
The chapter-complete card is separate from the three mission cards; wait for all four.
Take a manual save before the last Chapter 4 mission in case a mission-specific flag fails to register.
Final check: reconcile “Top Of The World, Ma” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The last mission awards a gold. PowerPyx and Output Lag both place it after Chapter 5, so finish the epilogue chain before expecting it.

steps.text: Follow the final mission chain to the end of the story; do not leave for cleanup early.
The trophy is graded gold, so check the result screen before closing the game.
Complete Chapter 5 first — sources map Operation Savage Glory to that chapter.
No difficulty setting raises or lowers the award; Push Square notes the list has no difficulty trophies.
After the final card, save manually: Chapter 5 is the natural boundary before 100% cleanup.
Final check: reconcile “You Gotta Know When to Get Off” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Trust is the Breakfast Run mission trophy. It sits near the opening, so an early save protects it while you experiment.

steps.text: Accept Breakfast Run as soon as the marker appears in the early chapter.
Complete every objective through the hand-off; the mission card is the proof.
Finish it before you start ranged collectible sweeps, which can bury the marker.
The trophy is bronze and not medal-gated, so a clean completion is enough.
If the card is missed, replay from the pre-mission save and verify the entry in your tracker.
Final check: reconcile “Trust” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Break the Bank is the Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. gta.guide supplies the mission mapping; the official description is the authority on the trigger.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 3 and open the heist preparation chain from the yellow marker.
Complete The Cartel Heist with the full crew objective list checked off.
The trophy is awarded on the heist's completion screen, not on the chapter card.
Clear the Race Against Yago missable in the same chapter while you are in the area.
Keep the manual save from before the heist until both the mission and chapter flags show on your list.
Final check: reconcile “Break the Bank” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Family Matters maps to Child's Play in Chapter 4. The mapping is cross-checked across two guide sites; the trigger remains the mission card.

steps.text: Enter Chapter 4 and pick up Child's Play when its marker unlocks.
Finish the mission's final objective without leaving the mission area early.
Check the mission-complete card; Family Matters pops there rather than at a chapter boundary.
Do the other two Chapter 4 mission trophies in the same sitting to keep the act straight.
If a flag looks lost, replay from the manual save rather than starting a new game.
Final check: reconcile “Family Matters” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: DWNFALL is Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. Two independent mappings agree, so treat the mission as the only trigger you need.

steps.text: Open the Chapter 4 mission board and select Headliners.
Play through to the last objective and stay inside the mission until the card appears.
The bronze award is attached to the mission card, not to a medal time.
Chapter 4 also hosts stranger strands; deal with those after this card so nothing overlaps.
Note the DWNFALL label in your tracker — the in-game mission name is different.
Final check: reconcile “DWNFALL” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Hi-Jacked is VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. The name is a puzzle; the mission card is the practical trigger.

steps.text: Start VCIA Takedown from the Chapter 4 marker list.
Complete the takedown sequence through its last scripted objective.
Expect the Hi-Jacked trophy on the mission-complete card.
PowerPyx recommends one playthrough; keep this mission inside that single run.
Save after the card so the rest of Chapter 4 can be attempted safely.
Final check: reconcile “Hi-Jacked” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Snow Storm is Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 set piece. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale.

steps.text: Advance to Chapter 5 and trigger Operation Savage Glory from the main objective.
Stay with the set piece until the operation ends and the mission card resolves.
The trophy name is thematic; the official description names the real mission.
Finish the remaining Chapter 5 lead-in before the final mission, as the roadmap places them back to back.
Take a manual save at this boundary — it is the last safe point before the platinum cleanup.
Final check: reconcile “Snow Storm” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: A Long Road is the 100% gold and the hardest item in the set. PowerPyx puts it last and estimates a very long completion sweep.

steps.text: Read 100% as the game's own percentage menu, not a personal checklist of favourites.
Finish the story first, since several completion categories are chapter-gated.
Track the listed counts — challenges, meditations, vaults, gang operations and vehicles — from the checklist tab.
Leave cheats off throughout; a cheated session cannot award the trophy.
Expect roughly two hundred hours from the roadmap estimate and plan the sweep in blocks.
Final check: reconcile “A Long Road” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Cunning Stunts is a raw stunt counter. BestGTA6 quotes a higher target than the official text, so follow PlayStation's 250.

steps.text: Use the counter on the trophy panel as the authority; the official description says 250 stunts.
Chain jumps, air rotations and near-misses on open roads rather than hunting a single trick.
Count only stunts the game registers — the on-screen stunt banner is your proof.
Fold this into normal driving so the counter grows during story travel.
Where secondary guides quote 300, treat that as an estimate for other completion categories.
Check the tally at each manual-save boundary and stop as soon as the official figure is met.
Final check: reconcile “Cunning Stunts” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Master of None asks for one attempt at every activity type. It is a sampler, not a mastery award.

steps.text: Open the activity menu and list each distinct type before you begin.
Play one round of each type, even if you finish last or bail at the results screen.
The trophy checks participation, so a single completed attempt per type is enough.
Mark each type off in the tracker as you go; there is no in-game counter to lean on.
Keep attempts inside one save file — there are no online-only activity types.
If a type does not register, repeat it once before assuming the list is longer.
Final check: reconcile “Master of None” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The Shootist needs gold in all Shooting Range challenges. Exophase and Game Checklists both put the range count at 42.

steps.text: Visit the Shooting Range and work through the challenge board from top to bottom.
Earn gold, not just a pass — silver finishes do not tick this trophy.
Replay any challenge whose medal stays silver until the gold condition is met.
Use a steady controller setup; the range challenges are timing based, not story gated.
Keep a separate tally of 42 golds, because the range menu does not always show a single total.
Cross-check the final count against Exophase before calling the sweep done.
Final check: reconcile “The Shootist” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun wants a drone race win at every venue. gta.guide lists all drone races among the completion categories.

steps.text: Collect the drone race locations from the map before entering your first race.
Win each race outright — finishing without first place does not count.
Travel between venues in one session and mark each win in the tracker.
If a venue is locked, come back after the chapter that opens that district.
Replay the closest race to learn the course before moving to the next one.
Verify the venue list against a second guide so a single missed location does not stall cleanup.
Final check: reconcile “Top Fun” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Earn Cash, Not Kudos is a variety counter: twenty different races, not twenty wins in the same event.

steps.text: Open the race list and note which events you have never entered.
Win twenty distinct race events, switching venue and discipline as you go.
A repeated event does not advance the counter, so keep a written list.
Blend racing into travel after the story so the counter grows naturally.
Check the trophy counter after each win rather than assuming the menu updates instantly.
Final check: reconcile “Earn Cash, Not Kudos” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Baited My Tackle is a single duel with Cal. The fishing challenge only appears once you have built the relationship.

steps.text: Advance the fishing side strand until Cal issues his challenge.
Accept the duel from the fishing spot marker rather than from a random shoreline.
Win the challenge on weight or speed, depending on the round's stated goal.
If you lose, replay from the challenge prompt; losing does not lock the trophy.
Save before the duel so repeated attempts are cheap.
Confirm the bronze on the results screen before moving on.
Final check: reconcile “Baited My Tackle” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Stick Fiddler only needs one arcade game completed to its end screen.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida and interact with it from the prompt.
Play a full game to the results screen; quitting early does not register.
Any game on the cabinet qualifies — the description says one, not a specific title.
Use a short game if you only need the trophy, then leave the cabinet.
Check the tracker immediately after the results screen.
Final check: reconcile “Stick Fiddler” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's final mission closes his stranger strand. gta.guide tracks the stranger strands as a group of eight.

steps.text: Start Andy's strand early and return to each follow-up marker as it appears.
Complete Andy's last mission when it unlocks, through its final objective.
Count this strand toward the eight needed for Strangers & Freaks.
Do not leave the strand half-finished across chapter changes without noting it.
Keep a manual save before the last mission in case a follow-up is time sensitive.
Final check: reconcile “Road to Rehabilitation” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with its own mission trophy and also feeds the eight-strand silver.

steps.text: Pick up Kenton's first job when the marker appears in the chapter that opens it.
Work every follow-up in order; the last mission unlocks only after the chain.
Finish that last mission through the completion card.
Log the strand in your tracker alongside the other seven.
Finish it before the final chapter so cleanup has fewer open threads.
Final check: reconcile “This Was No Boat Accident” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's last mission is the final step of another stranger strand. The same eight-strand silver counts it.

steps.text: Begin Billy's strand as soon as its first marker shows on the map.
Clear the intermediate jobs so the final mission becomes available.
Complete Billy's last mission and wait for the mission card.
Mark the strand as closed in your notes for the Strangers & Freaks tally.
Replay from a manual save if the follow-up marker disappears.
Final check: reconcile “The Lone Rider” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks needs eight complete stranger strands. gta.guide names eight full strands; BestGTA6 adds a missable race inside one of them.

steps.text: List the eight stranger strands from the guide and open each in its chapter.
Finish every mission inside a strand — a strand with one job left does not count.
Bank the Race Against Yago beat in Chapter 3, which BestGTA6 flags as missable.
Check the silver's counter after each closed strand instead of guessing.
Keep the remaining side jobs until after the story so no strand is missed.
Use the companion tracker to cross-check the eight flags at the end.
Final check: reconcile “Strangers & Freaks” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with its own final mission. Treat it like the other seven stranger chains.

steps.text: Trigger Randy's first job from the map marker when the strand opens.
Complete each follow-up before starting a different stranger chain.
Finish Randy's last mission and confirm the card.
Count the closed strand toward the eight required for the silver.
Save at the boundary in case a later chapter re-locks the marker.
Final check: reconcile “Supply & Demand” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is the last of the named final-mission chain trophies. Complete it like the others.

steps.text: Open Tyrone's strand from its first mission marker in the correct chapter.
Clear the chain in order until Tyrone's last mission is offered.
Complete that mission through its final objective and card.
Tick the strand off your eight-strand tally.
If the marker is absent, check whether an earlier follow-up remains open.
Final check: reconcile “Spin On This!” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Positive Mental Attitude wants every meditation spot. It is the one trophy sources disagree on: the Chapter 1 balcony window may be time sensitive.

steps.text: Use the meditation list of 18 spots as your master sheet; the trophy tracks all of them.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation during that chapter — PowerPyx calls it the possible missable.
Hold the meditation input until the animation completes; a tap does not register the spot.
Scan the map for the remaining spots while driving between story markers.
Mark each completed spot in the YOUR COUNT control so the 18/18 total is visible.
Because sources conflict, keep the pre-chapter manual save until the balcony spot is confirmed.
Final check: reconcile “Positive Mental Attitude” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

disputes.question: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation permanently missable?
disputes.positionA: PowerPyx and Output Lag flag a Chapter 1 balcony spot as a possible missable — do it inside Chapter 1. [1][2]
disputes.positionB: gta.guide and Leonida Interactive present meditation as a free-roam list, implying later revisits are allowed. [3][10]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Fair Game is Bret's unique-animal hunt. gta.guide counts 15 hunts, while the trophy needs the unique quarry.

steps.text: Meet Bret and accept his hunting request when the stranger marker appears.
Track the unique animal he names rather than hunting any rare specimen.
Use a clean shot and collect the kill so the request updates.
Complete the full set of Bret's hunts if your completion percentage depends on it.
Return to Bret for the hand-in; the trophy fires there, not at the kill.
Save before the hand-in in case the quest flag needs a retry.
Final check: reconcile “Fair Game” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Don't Touch My Deck needs three full collectible card sets. The cards are spread across Leonida and are easy to sweep while driving.

steps.text: Collect cards from every location on the gta.guide collectibles index.
Sort cards into sets as you pick them up; three completed sets are required.
Trade or bank a set at the relevant vendor so the game registers completion.
Repeat until the silver's set counter reads three.
Fold card collection into your driving routes to avoid a separate sweep.
Cross-check the set count in the companion tracker before finishing.
Final check: reconcile “Don't Touch My Deck” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: You WAiNKer! is a scanning counter: WAiNK It at one hundred locations. Know GTA 6 recommends doing it while you drive.

steps.text: Unlock WAiNK It and keep it active while moving through the map.
Scan distinct locations rather than the same landmark repeatedly.
Watch the counter on the trophy panel and log it whenever you pass 25.
Plan a road route that crosses new districts to avoid doubling back.
Finish the story first if a location is locked behind a chapter.
Stop at the official 100, even if a checklist quotes another count.
Final check: reconcile “You WAiNKer!” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: One Last Thing asks for fifty Challenges. gta.guide counts 70 or 80 in the wider completion set, so the trophy target is the smaller number.

steps.text: Open the challenges menu and read the official target of 50.
Complete any fifty listed challenges; the specific mix is not prescribed.
Prefer short challenges first to build momentum and unlock harder variants.
Check the trophy counter after every ten challenges to catch a stuck flag.
Do not confuse this with the 42 range challenges, which have their own trophy.
Finish the remaining challenges later only if 100% completion needs them.
Final check: reconcile “One Last Thing” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Hot Together is a partner moment: shed a four-star wanted level together and stay free long enough for the escape to register.

steps.text: Trigger a four-star wanted level with your partner present in the vehicle.
Drive away as a pair and break line of sight until the stars begin to drop.
Stay out of pursuit until the wanted level is fully gone; the escape is the trigger.
Use a manual save before provoking the police so retries are quick.
Confirm the trophy after the heat clears rather than mid-chase.
Final check: reconcile “Hot Together” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Retail Therapy needs three back-to-back shop robberies with your partner and without losing the wanted level.

steps.text: Pick three shops close together so travel time cannot clear the alert.
Rob the first shop with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level active.
Move straight to the second and third shops without shaking the police.
The chain breaks if the wanted level drops, so avoid hiding between hits.
Save beforehand and retry the sequence if the third robbery does not register.
Final check: reconcile “Retail Therapy” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Whip It Good is vehicle discovery. BestGTA6 puts the wider vehicle total at 200, but the trophy asks for 100.

steps.text: Drive or enter one hundred distinct vehicle models across Leonida.
Each new model adds to the discovery counter; repeats do not help.
Rotate vehicle classes — road, off-road, air and water — to find unseen models quickly.
Check the discovery list in the menu and fill the gaps near each garage.
Save before a long drive so a crash does not cost the session.
Stop at the official 100 unless the 100% category needs the larger list.
Final check: reconcile “Whip It Good” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Gunslinger is a single combat-focus burst: five enemies in one use. Save it for a crowded encounter.

steps.text: Build a wanted level or find a guarded location with at least five enemies.
Activate Combat Focus only when all five targets are visible.
Take down five enemies before the focus meter expires.
If you get four, reload and try a denser encounter rather than a new area.
The trophy fires on the fifth takedown inside the same use.
Final check: reconcile “Gunslinger” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Catch Me If You Can is an unscheduled departure at VCIA — a stunt, not a story objective.

steps.text: Travel to VCIA with a fast vehicle and note the departure route.
Ignore the scheduled exit and drive through the restricted departure path.
Keep going until the game registers the unscheduled departure.
Expect a wanted response; use a save made before the attempt.
If the phrase confuses you, treat it as a map boundary event rather than a mission.
Final check: reconcile “Catch Me If You Can” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Challenging Tank is the Rhino encounter hinted at in the official description. Cleanup guides group it with the unusual vehicles.

steps.text: Locate a Rhino tank after the story unlocks military areas.
Get close enough to trigger the encounter rather than destroying it from range.
Survive or resolve the encounter until the trophy condition registers.
Use a manual save — tanks attract attention that is hard to shake.
Check the trophy panel before leaving the area.
The cleanup route in Know GTA 6 places this alongside the UFO and airliner oddities.
Final check: reconcile “Challenging Tank” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Sneakthief wants a jewelry store robbery with zero detection. Patience matters more than speed.

steps.text: Scout a jewelry store and note guard patrols and camera angles.
Enter unseen, using cover and distraction rather than force.
Take the goods and exit without raising the alarm at any stage.
If the alarm sounds, reload the pre-robbery save — stealth must be perfect.
Verify the trophy on exit rather than after you reach a safehouse.
Final check: reconcile “Sneakthief” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Maximum Withdrawal is a five-vault spree. BestGTA6 counts eight vaults on the map, so you have spare choices.

steps.text: Choose five bank vaults from the eight locations listed by BestGTA6.
Rob each vault and escape alive — a bust does not complete the entry.
Track which vaults are already banked so you do not repeat one.
Use different districts to avoid overlapping cooldowns between jobs.
The silver fires on the fifth successful escape.
Keep the remaining vaults for the 100% sweep if it needs them.
Final check: reconcile “Maximum Withdrawal” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A Classic Blitz Play is one armored truck robbery and a clean escape.

steps.text: Find an armored truck on patrol after the story unlocks the heist activity.
Stop it and take the cargo before reinforcements arrive.
Escape the pursuit zone intact; the trophy needs the getaway.
Use a fast vehicle and a saved game before the attempt.
Confirm the bronze after the escape prompt clears.
Final check: reconcile “A Classic Blitz Play” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The Goodtime State asks you to explore all of Leonida. Treat the map's district coverage as the checklist.

steps.text: Open the map and identify every named district and region.
Travel through each one, triggering its discovery marker.
Include offshore and rural areas that are easy to miss on a road-only route.
Mark every visited region in your tracker so the last one is obvious.
Combine this with vehicle discovery and WAiNK scanning to save time.
Finish after Chapter 5 if any district is story-locked.
Final check: reconcile “The Goodtime State” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Pest Control wants one illegal operation from each gang. BestGTA6 counts 39 gang operations in total.

steps.text: List the gangs that run illegal operations in Leonida from the guide.
Rob one operation belonging to each gang — repeats do not advance the trophy.
Note the gang name beside each operation in your checklist.
Complete the escape for each job so the flag is recorded.
Spread the jobs across districts to combine them with map exploration.
If a gang's operation is locked, come back after the relevant chapter.
Final check: reconcile “Pest Control” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: In The Beginning… is a small location action: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: Travel to Ocean Beach and locate the viewpoint bar.
Order the cocktail from the interaction prompt and stay for the view animation.
Wait for the on-screen confirmation — leaving early can skip the trigger.
Do it during free roam after the prologue so the area is open.
Log the action in the tracker and move on.
Final check: reconcile “In The Beginning…” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Capital Offense is a showroom stunt: smash your way out in classic style.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom with a heavy vehicle or a clear exit route.
Drive through the showroom glass to make the classic exit.
Keep moving until the game registers the smash — stopping inside may not count.
Save beforehand in case the vehicle is impounded.
Check the trophy panel after leaving the area.
Final check: reconcile “Capital Offense” with the cited guides in the Sources tab before the entry is called done.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
